name: @novadeck/sandbox
description: An isolated environment for tests and benchmarks that run real shells and programs: a scrubbed environment with a throwaway home, reaping what it started, and a tripwire over writes outside it.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; cpSync('src/reap-lister.cs', 'dist/reap-lister.cs')"
